environment: Local production Next.js and fictional local Supabase; Playwright intercepts one planning GET or assistant turn
result: PASS 2/2 focused after final fix and included in PASS 26/26 combined production-browser run
failure_then_fix: A simulated planning HTTP 503 initially left an old exact-handover button visible; a simulated assistant HTTP 503 initially left the previous answer visible. After the fixes, failed current-state reads hide cached review/handover/draft/preflight controls, and a new conversational turn clears its old answer. Local Stop remains available. Removing each interception and making a fresh read restores the current handover or answer and clears the error.
limits: These two tests use browser-level simulated 503s. A separate db-recovery.json drill used a real app-to-Postgres database-selection failure. Neither proves a database-service outage, AWS/provider outage, hosted failover or production recovery time.
